b'# tinydl

A simple command-line tool for downloading files from URLs.

## CLI Options

| Option | Short | Long | Help Text |
|--------|-------|------|-----------|
| `--url` | - | `--url` | what to download |
| `--output` | `-o` | `--output` | file to write (default: stdout) |
| `--quiet` | `-q` | `--quiet` | no progress output |
'
